headline: Suzano Raises Pulp Prices by $50 per Tonne in Europe and North America
summary: Brazilian pulp producer Suzano announced a $50 per tonne price increase for cellulose in Europe and North America, setting its European list price to $1,410 per tonne.
why: Suzano is the world's largest hardwood pulp producer, making its pricing decisions a benchmark for the global paper and packaging industry.

impacts.name: Suzano
impacts.why: Higher pulp list prices improve revenue expectations and profit margins for the producer.

why_moved: Pulp price increases directly boost revenue projections for major producers like Suzano.
